intro: The hall still smells of sawdust and cold coffee, and the grandmasters move through it as if the floor were a board only they can see. On the night of the Endgame Study, one of them stood from a winning position, signed the scoresheet with a hand that did not tremble, and walked out into the rain without a word; he has not been heard of since. The sheet he left is framed by the arbiters not as a game but as a refusal, though it is written in the same hand and ink as every other sheet in the drawer. The door-keeper, who has seen stranger exits, keeps his little book in a way no outsider has questioned: for each departure he writes the study's name and, just after it, the place where the hand had stopped. When the remaining grandmasters settle again, the silence is not disappointment but recognition: a line has been drawn that only some of them can follow.
echo: The Persian shah was never killed; he was simply left with nowhere to go.

puzzles.title: Fianchetto
puzzles.flavor: Three letters to a strip, and a note of how long each word was.
hints: The strips are alphabetised, not in order. The word lengths say where the breaks fall. Which strip could start the sentence?

puzzles.title: Opposition
puzzles.flavor: None of these clocks is broken. None of them tells the time. Half a turn of the wheel and you'd have it.

hints: Imagine each of these as a person holding two flags out at arm's length. Sailors had an alphabet for that. And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: Smothered Mate
puzzles.flavor: Only one page survived. It was the only page anyone needed.

blocks.text: A grandmaster resigned in a winning position, left the hall, and never played again. His scoresheet was not a game at all.

hints: The first number in each pair never goes past the number of words on the page. What does the second count?

puzzles.title: Poisoned Pawn
puzzles.flavor: Take stock of everything you recognise. Whoever copied it out was standing in front of a mirror.

blocks.text: Somewhere in here: things to do with the tournament hall.

puzzles.title: Sealed Move
puzzles.flavor: The typist's hands were fine. Their aim was not. Unlucky for some, and the same distance either way.

meta.title: Meta: The Endgame Study
meta.flavor: The porter only ever noted where each passenger boarded.
hints: Every entry has two numbers. What in this round is numbered, and what could the second number count?
